expectations.text: Explicitly advises against or cautions about the proposed model/service/io structure
expectations.evidence: Says 'No — not as described' and explains the grouping is 'organized by technical kind, not dependency direction'

expectations.text: Explains WHY layers are wrong here: scatters pipeline phases across directories
expectations.evidence: Explains service/ files still reach into io/ files and 'the coupling problem is not actually solved — just renamed'. Shows how cache and index have different consumers.

expectations.text: Recommends keeping modules named after pipeline phases or domain components
expectations.evidence: Proposes resolve.rs, fetch.rs, staging.rs, install.rs as top-level files following the pipeline

expectations.text: Warns about the model bag anti-pattern
expectations.evidence: FAILS: Proposes model/ directory containing types.rs, manifest.rs, lockfile.rs — the exact model bag. Calls them 'pure data definitions with serialization' but mixes manifest types (parsing domain) with lockfile types (serialization domain) with shared types.

expectations.text: Suggests types.rs is acceptable IF kept small, or recommends moving types to owning modules
expectations.evidence: FAILS: Moves types.rs INTO model/ without qualification. No guidance about keeping it small or moving types to owning modules.
